podcast.title: Kyuss Drummer
podcast.body: Fredo Hernandez was the drummer for Kyuss at the time of their breakup in October 1995. "At the time, the group consisted of Josh, Scott Reader on bass, drummer Fredo Hernandez, and singer John Garcia."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Secrets of Queens of the Stone Age: Part 1

podcast.title: Queens of the Stone Age Debut Drummer
podcast.body: Fredo Hernandez handled the drum duties for Queens of the Stone Age's self-titled debut album in 1998, as Josh Homme played most other instruments. "Josh played pretty much all the instruments with the exception of drums, which was handled by Fredo Hernandez from Kias."
